newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen's Islah head re-elected parliament speaker.
newsitem.headline: Yemen's Islah head re-elected parliament speaker.

text.p: The head of Yemen's Islah party, the Islamist junior coalition partner in the outgoing government, was re-elected as parliament speaker for a second term on Sunday.
Sheikh Abdullah bin Hussein al-Ahmar won the seat by a show of hands after the 301-seat parliament held its first session following last month's general elections.
Yemeni President Ali Abdullah Saleh's General People's Congress (GPC) won a landslide victory in the poll, the first since a 1994 civil war.
He swore in a new government on Saturday of mostly GPC members after the ruling party captured 187 seats. Islah won 53 seats and said it would join the opposition.
Independents won 54 seats and two opposition parties took a total of five seats. Results for two seats have yet to be announced.
